script: CPI drops tomorrow. Quick quiz — what does smart money do the day before? Most traders get this completely wrong. Question: Smart money positions before CPI by doing what? A) Chasing breakouts. B) Sweeping liquidity. C) Waiting for confirmation. If you said A — chasing breakouts — that's exactly what retail does. And smart money feeds off that. If you said C — waiting for confirmation — you're still late. News candles move 80 pips in seconds. You're already missing it. The answer is B. Smart money sweeps liquidity BEFORE the news prints. They grab stops above old highs, then reverse hard. Watch DXY tomorrow morning. If it sweeps buyside liquidity before CPI — that's your signal. That's the R2F Trading system in real time.
